about: The line rule of a line note:the text split on LF, one CR cut off each line's end, no line after a final newline; a lone CR and U+2028 stay in the line; the BOM is dropped when the file is read; a quote is a line's first 300 code points. The server's tests read this file; the page's count must match it.
